notes: Direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) got the homepage (200) but every /shop/holidays/* PLP returned a 403 Akamai 'Restricted Access' page; Playwright headless Chromium got 403 even on the homepage. Both are consistent with Akamai Bot Manager blocking this sandbox's datacenter egress IP (WSGEO cookie also resolved the sandbox IP to India/Delhi, triggering a 'Looks like you're in India' interstitial that had to be dismissed on every real-browser load, confirmed via Claude-in-Chrome, to reach the true US storefront). Per the access-tier rule, escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3), which loaded all pages correctly. The Chrome extension session was heavily shared/contended with other concurrent extraction workers during this run (tabs were repeatedly evicted/reused by other agents), which is why two subcategory URLs (Ramadan, and a few smaller Christmas facets) could not be double-checked further. Main nav 'Holidays' (/shop/fall-winter-holidays/) mega menu currently surfaces 4 holiday tiles (Halloween, High Holidays & Hanukkah, Thanksgiving, Christmas) as the active season; sitemap (shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz) plus direct navigation confirmed additional live, genuine PLPs for New Year's Eve, Valentine's Day, Easter, 4th of July, Lunar New Year, Ramadan, and Passover that are not currently linked in the nav but remain real product-listing pages with their own filters/product grids -- included per rule that site taxonomy, not the current nav snapshot, is authoritative. Christmas is the only holiday with a genuine parent/child structure (a chip row of Category tiles plus additional PLPs found via sitemap); its own root PLP (/shop/holidays/christmas/) itself reports 897 Items so it is kept as a grouping row per Rule 0.6/9 rather than double-counted as a leaf -- the 12 captured children sum to 825, leaving a ~72-item gap versus the parent total that could not be fully reconciled (likely additional un-enumerated facets or products appearing in the flat list but not in any single curated facet) given tool-access constraints; this is recorded as a MANUAL REVIEW flag on the parent row rather than fabricating a number. '/shop/holidays/christmas-decorating/' redirects (cm_src=OLDLINK) to the same root Christmas PLP so was excluded as a duplicate, not a distinct subcategory. Halloween, Hanukkah/High Holidays, Thanksgiving, New Year's Eve, Valentine's Day, Easter, 4th of July, Lunar New Year, and Passover each render as a single flat PLP with filter facets but no further chip/subcategory PLPs, so each is recorded as one leaf row. Ramadan (/shop/holidays/ramadan-decor/) was confirmed as a genuine live PLP (same page template/SEO structure as Passover and Lunar New Year) but its exact item count could not be captured before the browser tab was reclaimed by another concurrent session, so qty is null with a manual-review flag rather than guessed. Excluded: 'Shop the Occasion' style Baby & Kids holiday branch (/shop/kids-holiday-gifts/*, /shop/baby-kids-halloween/) -- treated as a separate department/brand section rather than the core Holidays taxonomy, consistent with how Furniture/Office/Kids are separate top-level departments from Holidays on this site; not independently investigated further. No Gift Guide, Sale, Blog, Collections, or other marketing/navigation pages were extracted.
